data.current_summary: Approve or deny one member access request
data.current_description:
Approve or deny one pending member access request. The API key's creator must be allowed to change member roles in the workspace.

Approving promotes the requester from viewer to member when a seat is available and the workspace's membership policy allows it. A requester who is already a member or admin is fulfilled without using another seat. If the seat cannot be granted, for example because no seat is available or the workspace's roles are managed by an identity provider, the request becomes `fulfillment_failed` and no role changes.

Send `If-Match` with the list item's `reviewEtag` or the detail response's
complete strong `ETag`, unchanged.
The tag matches as long as no new event has been recorded on the request
since that read; changes to the requester's profile details alone do not
make it stale. A missing header returns 428
(`precondition_required`); a malformed or weak value returns 400
(`invalid_request`); a stale version returns 412
(`precondition_failed`); and a current tag on a request that is no longer
pending returns 409 (`request_already_resolved`).

A successful review returns 200 with the updated request, its public
history, a new `ETag`, and `Cache-Control: no-store, no-transform`.
`requester` is included only when the key also has `read:*`, and remains
null when requester details are unavailable. The ETag can differ from a
subsequent detail GET's ETag at the same request version.

A read made immediately after a review can briefly return the request's
previous state. If the response is lost, wait briefly and read the request
again. If it is resolved, do not retry; if it is still pending, retry only
with the latest read's ETag.

data.current_summary: Approve or deny one Budget limit increase request
data.current_description:
Approves or denies one pending Budget limit increase request. A successful approval also applies the Budget limit change.

The API key's creator must retain Budget-management access for the target
Workspace; `write:budgets` alone is insufficient. The approved `amountUsd`

Approving promotes the requester from viewer to member when a seat is available and the workspace's membership policy allows it. A requester who is already a member or admin is fulfilled without using another seat. If the seat cannot be granted, for example because no seat is available or the workspace's roles are managed by an identity provider, the request becomes `fulfillment_failed` and no role changes.

Send `If-Match` with the list item's `reviewEtag` or the detail response's
complete strong `ETag`, unchanged.
The tag matches as long as no new event has been recorded on the request
since that read; changes to the requester's profile details alone do not
make it stale. A missing header returns 428
(`precondition_required`); a malformed or weak value returns 400
(`invalid_request`); a stale version returns 412
(`precondition_failed`); and a current tag on a request that is no longer
pending returns 409 (`request_already_resolved`).

A successful review returns 200 with the updated request, its public
history, a new `ETag`, and `Cache-Control: no-store, no-transform`.
`requester` is included only when the key also has `read:*`, and remains
null when requester details are unavailable. The ETag can differ from a
subsequent detail GET's ETag at the same request version.

A read made immediately after a review can briefly return the request's
previous state. If the response is lost, wait briefly and read the request
again. If it is resolved, do not retry; if it is still pending, retry only
with the latest read's ETag.

data.current_summary: Approve or deny one Budget limit increase request
data.current_description:
Approves or denies one pending Budget limit increase request. A successful approval also applies the Budget limit change.

The API key's creator must retain Budget-management access for the target
Workspace; `write:budgets` alone is insufficient. The approved `amountUsd`
is the final limit, not an increment, and must exceed the current limit.
An amount at or below the current limit returns 409 (`conflict`).

For a `workspace_group_limit` request, approval increases the shared limit
of the group identified by `groupId`, not the requester's individual limit.
Other applicable usage limits remain in effect.

Send the list item's `reviewEtag` or the detail response's strong ETag
unchanged in `If-Match`. A new event on the request makes an earlier review token stale; changes to
the requester's profile, Workspace details, or group name alone do not.
A missing header returns 428 (`precondition_required`); a malformed or weak
value returns 400 (`invalid_request`); a stale version returns 412
(`precondition_failed`); and a current tag on a request that is no longer
pending returns 409 (`request_already_resolved`). A concurrent budget
update can instead return 409 (`budget_update_in_progress`) with
`Retry-After: 1`.

A successful review returns 200 with the updated request, its public
history, a new `ETag`, and `Cache-Control: no-store, no-transform`.
Both `requester` and `workspace` are always null in review responses.
Group requests retain `groupId`, but `group` is also null, even when the
key also has `read:*`. The ETag can differ from a subsequent
detail GET's ETag at the same request version. Either token can be used
for a review; use the detail GET's ETag for conditional detail reads.
This operation returns the updated request, not a separate review resource.

A read made immediately after a review can briefly return the request's
previous state. If the response is lost, wait briefly and read the request
again. If it is resolved, do not retry; if
still pending, retry only if the decision is still intended and use the
latest read's ETag.
data.summary_suggestion: Review and approve or deny a budget limit increase request
data.description_suggestion:
Reviews a pending Budget limit increase request by approving or denying it. Approval applies the requested Budget limit change to the target Workspace or group.

**Required Permissions:** The API key's creator must retain Budget-management access for the target Workspace; `write:budgets` alone is insufficient.

**Input:** Requires the `requestId` and a request body specifying the decision (approve/deny) and approved `amountUsd` (if approving). The approved amount must exceed the current limit; amounts at or below current limits return 409 conflict. Include the current `ETag` in the `If-Match` header for optimistic concurrency control.

**Output:** Returns 200 with the updated request, its public history, and a new `ETag`. Note that `requester` and `workspace` fields are always null in review responses; group requests retain `groupId` but `group` is also null.

**Side Effects:** Approval immediately applies the new Budget limit. Concurrent budget updates may return 409 with `Retry-After: 1`. Stale ETags return 412; missing headers return 428. Requests already resolved return 409.

**Concurrency:** Use the detail response's `ETag` for conditional reads. A read immediately after review may briefly return the previous state; if the response is lost, wait and retry only if the decision is still intended.

data.summary_suggestion: Retrieve Account audit messages with prompt text
data.description_suggestion:
Retrieves Account audit messages enriched with full prompt text from `project.message_sent` events. Results are scoped to the authenticated Account; the Account cannot be specified in the request.

**Required Parameters:** First request must specify `occurredAfter` and `occurredBefore` parameters defining a time window no longer than 24 hours over the `occurredAt` field. Subsequent requests use pagination cursors (valid for 1 hour).

**Optional Parameters:** `messageRef` filters to events with exact match for the opaque reference value (do not parse or transform). `limit` controls response size.

**Output:** Events are ordered by `occurredAt` and `eventId` ascending. Each response contains only complete events and is limited to 8 MiB uncompressed UTF-8 JSON. Includes `promptText` field with user's full prompt and `observedAt` timestamp (when Replit received the event, may be later than `occurredAt`).

**Important Constraints:** Events may become available after their `occurredAt` time. This API does not guarantee completeness or provide a completion watermark. Deduplicate events by `eventId`. Polling with overlapping time windows reduces risk of missing late events.

**Error Handling:** Invalid cursors return 400 `invalid_cursor`. Events exceeding size limit return 422 `audit_log_content_too_large`. Cursor parameters must match original request; mismatches return errors.

**Example:** `GET /v1/compliance/messages?occurredAfter=2026-08-04T00%3A00%3A00Z&occurredBefore=2026-08-05T00%3A00%3A00Z&messageRef=message123&limit=25`

data.current_summary: Get Account usage and gross ledger cost
data.current_description:
Returns usage-ledger consumption and gross cost from the same provider used by Replit's Usage settings page.
Omit workspaceId, groupId, userId, and projectId for Account-wide totals. Filters are intersected when combined.

groupId requires workspaceId and filters usage to users who are active group members when the request is processed. Deleted or disabled memberships, deleted users, and support seats are excluded. An explicit userId is intersected with current group membership. Users can belong to multiple groups, so totals from separate group requests are not additive. Ungrouped and unattributed usage is excluded from group-filtered requests. groupId supports totals, groupBy=member, groupBy=project, groupBy=conversations, and groupBy=timeseries; it cannot be combined with groupBy=workspace. The response does not repeat the group ID or expose group names or internal Account identifiers.

Example: `GET /v1/usage?workspaceId=workspace123&groupId=groupEngineering&groupBy=member`

Omit all range parameters for the current billing period. billingPeriod cannot be combined with startTime or endTime.
Custom ranges require both startTime and endTime, use inclusive start and exclusive end boundaries, and cannot exceed 366 days.
groupBy adds one breakdown; granularity is valid only with groupBy=timeseries.
groupBy=member includes every selected metric type and is not limited to Agent usage.
With groupBy=project, breakdownBy=member adds a complete member breakdown and explicit unattributed-member metrics to every selected project. Pagination counts projects, and members are ordered by descending cost with userId as the tie-breaker. Requests without breakdownBy retain the existing response shape.
Example: `GET /v1/usage?groupBy=project&breakdownBy=member&limit=100`
Breakdown responses are limited to 10,000 project/member/metric detail rows and 8 MiB of JSON. A result exceeding these bounds returns 422 usage_breakdown_too_large without partial data. Reduce limit, narrow the interval, or apply filters to retry. A cursor can be retried with a smaller limit; adding or removing breakdownBy invalidates the cursor.
groupBy=conversations returns one environmentType=conversation group. attributableTotalCostUsd is conversation spend, and unattributableTotalCostUsd is all remaining spend for the selected filters.

Recent usage can arrive after a response. Costs are gross usage-ledger values, not settled invoice totals. Account credits, discounts, and net charges are intentionally excluded.
